chapter: Charlie Johnson, Willie Gant and the late 1920s
title: Snowden, gigging and joining Charlie Johnson at Small's Paradise
summary: After Snowden he gigged until joining Charlie Johnson's summer replacement band at Small's in 1926 while Johnson was in Atlantic City.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

blocks.x: Yeah. Well now, Elmer's in banjo, right?
He was in the Bandville Club.
I was with Cliff at the nest club.
Well, when do you go with Snowden?
I worked with Snowden after he came out of the Bandville Club.
And we gigged around, you know, with -- I was playing for different little club dates, and there'd be two, three, weeks
Well, so you (unintelligible) Then you were gigging around with Elmer Snowden until you go with Charlie Johnson?
Small's Paradise (unintelligible). You see, what happened, Charlie went to Atlantic City with his original band, and he asked (unintelligible) put the band in there for the summer.
